name: SR (Synchronizing Resources)
summary: University of Arizona concurrent programming language built on resources and operations that uniformly support procedure call, RPC, rendezvous, message passing, multicast and semaphores; succeeded by MPD.

level_notes.0: The SR 2.3 implementation is distributed (unmaintained) from the University of Arizona site.
level_notes.1: Defined by Andrews & Olsson, 'The SR Programming Language: Concurrency in Practice' (1993).
level_notes.2: The textbook 'The SR Programming Language: Concurrency in Practice' (1993) is not freely online.
